scope: R5 independent checker, fixed replay wrapper, retained-envelope integrity and focused negative controls

implementation.domain: Ordered thirteen-coordinate modular lifts; repeated parent residues allowed; nonzero modulo prime required; source/root/level/dependency sealed
implementation.independent_algorithm: Python integer arithmetic exhausts the whole j=0..M-1 grid for singleton survivors, versus primary symmetric half-grid search; separately folds omit-one uniform gcd from targetLevel
implementation.coverage: Unique reachable acyclic single-parent flat tree, exact complete root box, ordered disjoint exhaustive Cartesian axis partitions
implementation.classification: GRID witnesses accept equality; OMIT_GCD requires the exact uniform gcd greater than one; SURVIVOR is singleton, no grid witness and no omit-one gcd condition
implementation.dependency: LOWER_LRC_12_DECLARED_NOT_REPLAYED remains mandatory in scope and every summary
implementation.execution: Exact pinned reviewed source bytes via python3 -I -S -B -c; no source-path reopen, author executable, producer import, network or model code; shell false and environment allowlist
implementation.limits: 20,000 tuples, 40,000 nodes, 8 MiB certificate, prime17..257, level<=14; absolute observed 10-second host deadline, remaining child timeout/SIGKILL, 256 KiB output
implementation.retention: Strict certificate/primary/independent envelope with source/output/root/scope/evidence digests; pure retained validation reads no files and spawns no tools

controls: Pinned actual source bytes and exact equality at N14/p17/level14 with repeated residue1
Exact uniform omit-one gcd, fake prime divisor, invalid omission, divisor1 and mixed-choice nonuniformity
Fully exhausted singleton survivor with exact retained digits/residues
Missing, overlapping, duplicate, unreachable, cyclic and reordered tree branches; root-scope shrinkage
Prime, level, source, root and lower-dependency drift; unknown fields and duplicate JSON keys
Fully rehashed summary counts, omitted/changed survivor, source/output fingerprint and PARTIAL downgrade
Injected source drift, timeout, output-overflow, unavailable process and malformed output
Production/staging denied; retained validation never invokes child process
verification.targeted_lint: Fresh two owned TypeScript files exit0, zero warnings
verification.six_imported_scopes: Core/Product/Contractor acceptance, not claimed from the diagnostic focused controls

failure_history: Initial targeted lint rejected test-local variable names module; renamed actual, final lint and focused suite passed
limitations: COMPLETE means every declared finite tuple was arithmetically classified; survivors may remain
OMIT_GCD's mathematical use still requires the explicitly unverified lower-case premise
No all-prime or full seven-to-the-thirteenth author tree verification, universal LRC acceptance or novelty certification
Source/output hashes are local trusted collector byte consistency, not external signatures or Python binary attestation
A summary exceeding the fixed output cap fails closed rather than dropping survivors
Synchronous TypeScript checks use observed deadline checkpoints, not arbitrary hard JS preemption
No old finite-v1 file changes, DB, worker, API/model, Git or deployment actions by this Builder
